assertions.description: Navigating an iframe carrying a connectionallowlist attribute sends the requirement to the framed server as the Sec-Required-Connection-Allowlist request header.
assertions.test: Header-only contract with no synchronous JS surface: verify on an origin-trial / flag-enabled build via the live echo route at ../required-header-echo/ (the frame reports the exact received header value).

assertions.description: A framed response whose Connection-Allowlist header is at least as strict as the requirement opts in, and the frame loads.
assertions.test: Requires an enforcing build plus a server response header: verify via ../optin-handshake/ frame 1 (served with Connection-Allowlist: (response-origin)).

assertions.description: A framed response may instead delegate via Allow-Connection-Allowlist-From naming the embedder origin or *, compared byte-for-byte like a CORS check.
assertions.test: Requires an enforcing build plus a server response header: verify via ../optin-handshake/ frame 2 (served with Allow-Connection-Allowlist-From: *).

assertions.description: A framed response that neither satisfies the requirement nor delegates is refused: the frame fails to load and a console message is logged.
assertions.test: Requires an enforcing build: verify via ../optin-handshake/ frame 3 (served with no opt-in headers) — it must show NO REPORT and a console block message.

assertions.description: about:srcdoc and data: documents opt in implicitly by inheriting the embedder's policy container; the inherited response-origin token re-resolves against each inheriting document's own origin.
assertions.test: Requires an enforcing build: verify via ../srcdoc-inheritance/ — the srcdoc frame must load, its same-origin probe succeed, and its cross-origin probe be refused.
